description: A React component for a user settings modal in Mattermost, handling display, preferences, and confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: UserSettingsModal
classes.description: React component class for managing user settings modal, including tabs, sections, confirmation, and loading states.

methods.name: handleResend
methods.description: Resends verification email and updates resendStatus state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds keydown event listener, fetches user preferences and user data if in admin mode.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes keydown event listener.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Scrolls to top when active tab changes.

methods.name: setLoadingFinished
methods.description: Sets loading state to false.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+A) to close modal.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides modal, with optional confirmation.

methods.name: handleHidden
methods.description: Resets active tab/section and calls onExited callback.

methods.name: handleCollapse
methods.description: Collapses modal view on mobile.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Confirms modal action, executes afterConfirm callback.

methods.name: handleCancelConfirmation
methods.description: Cancels confirmation modal.

methods.name: showConfirmModal
methods.description: Displays confirmation modal, executes callback after confirmation.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes modal with optional confirmation.

methods.name: collapseModal
methods.description: Collapses modal with optional confirmation.

methods.name: updateTab
methods.description: Updates active tab, with confirmation if required.

methods.name: updateSection
methods.description: Updates active section, with confirmation if required.

methods.name: getUserSettingsTabs
methods.description: Returns array of notification, display, sidebar, advanced tabs.

methods.name: getProfileSettingsTab
methods.description: Returns array of profile and security tabs.

methods.name: getPluginsSettingsTab
methods.description: Returns plugin-specific settings tabs.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with header, content, tabs, and confirmation modal.
